rationale: PINS pure-lexical module resolution (M52 analyzer-lane follow-up): import metadata.resolvedPath must be a deterministic function of (specifier, fromFile) with zero filesystem input, so the same repo indexes identically on every machine. Bare packages record logical identity (external:), builtins canonical node: form (node: prefix stripped, not doubled), relative imports resolve by path algebra. Only machine-independent rows pin resolvedPath (absolute relative resolutions vary by checkout path by construction).
